thread:
linda: Hi team — quick heads up: my rheumatologist recommended a 6-week reduced schedule and to be taken off pager/on-call for that period. I can do core hours (10–4) but not nights. apologies for the short notice, this flare hit hard this week.
kevin: Thanks for letting us know, Linda. Appreciate the heads up. We can cover the overnight rota but need to confirm who picks up the extra shifts. Also can we get a note for Peoples Ops so we can document?
Asha (People Ops): Hi @linda — I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. We should start the ADA interactive process. Can you fill the short accommodation form and upload the doc from your provider when you have it? Link: https://intranet.redwood/accom-form (or DM me and I’ll send the private form). We can set this as temporary (6 weeks) and revisit.
linda: Thanks @Asha — I uploaded a short note from the clinic, linked in the form. I’m open to coverage plans. Prefer not to escalate to disability leave if we can avoid it.
Jamal: I can take two of the overnight shifts while Linda is out. Happy to swap a weekend.
kevin: Big thanks Jamal. We’ll rearrange on-call. Two quick asks: 1) Linda, will you be able to join async async handoffs in the morning? 2) Asha, any docs HR needs from my side for coverage plan?
Asha (People Ops): 1) Morning handoffs at 10am are fine — we’ll mark that in the rota. 2) Manager note is helpful but not required; the provider note + employee request starts the process. We’ll formalize the temporary accommodation: adjusted schedule, on-call exemption, and weekly 1:1 check-ins with manager. We’ll also add a short coverage playbook so the team knows how to handle incidents.
kevin: Sounds good. I’ll mock up a one-page incident handoff template and Ping Jamal + others.
hr-bot: Accommodation form received for linda. Case ID: ACC-2026-1143. Next step: People Ops to schedule intake meeting.
linda: Appreciate everyone for being flexible. One question: will the adjusted schedule affect my performance review timeline?
Asha (People Ops): Good question. Short-term accommodations do not automatically affect cycle timelines. If you prefer, we can note this as a temporary adjustment and set explicit check-ins so goals are reasonable. If there’s any performance concern later, we’ll handle it separately and with notice.
kevin: I’ll ensure goals are aligned for the 6-week window and document the temporary exceptions.
Jamal: Happy to help. LMK if you want me to cover any specific runbooks.
linda: Thank you all — I’ll rest and follow the plan. :heart:
